title: MCP Server
description: Connect an AI agent to this workspace with an API key, over the Model Context Protocol.
subtitle: What an AI agent can read here, and how to connect one.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.hint: Point your MCP client at this address.

connect.title: To connect
connect.createKey: Create an API key in API Keys and give it the permission Use the MCP endpoint.
connect.pointClient: Send the key in the X-API-Key header (or as a Bearer token) to the address above.
connect.allowHost: If this installation answers on a public address, add its host to the allowed hosts in the module settings.

permissions.useDesc: A key without it cannot reach the MCP endpoint or list its tools

settings.allowedHostsDesc: Host headers the MCP endpoint accepts, besides localhost. One value per line.
settings.allowedOriginsDesc: Origin headers the MCP endpoint accepts, besides localhost. One value per line.
